ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 30% high-intensity white to 70% low-intensity black; high contrast distribution with dominant dark tones in the central region and brighter mottling towards the lateral edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, roughly rectangular high-intensity patches containing dense white-to-grey mottling are positioned on the outer lateral portions of both lobes. The central region surrounding the median notch is solid low-intensity black. Speckled transitions occur between the solid black and white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with a wide divergence angle (approximately 120 degrees) and shallow vertical depth relative to the horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency irregular serration along the entire trailing edge. A distinct, deep semi-circular notch (traumatic or congenital) is visible on the upper-mid trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edges that sweep upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixels (commensal barnacles) are concentrated on the distal tips of both lobes. Smaller, isolated rosettes are visible along the leading edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, vertically-oriented low-intensity linear marks are detectable within the white mottled patch on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent circular notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe; evidence of reddish/brown tissue or parasitic presence on the extreme tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, dark circular 'eye-like' spot of low-intensity pixels is located centrally within the white patch on the right lobe.
